summary_for_children: Al-Kawthar tells the Prophet (peace be upon him) he has been given abundance and to pray and sacrifice to Allah alone.
environment_concept: An orchard with full baskets, a sign of good things given. It is not a picture of al-Kawthar, which is not shown. A small clean terrace for prayer stands at its edge. No person is shown.
architecture_and_scenery: Fruit trees with full baskets, a raised stone prayer terrace with a low wall.

areas.name: Orchard of Plenty
areas.description: An orchard of full baskets: a sign of good things given, not a picture of al-Kawthar.

areas.name: Prayer Terrace
